title: ЯBOT Classroom message (v1)
description: One file per message. Learners write submissions, questions and approval requests to inbox/. Reviewers write responses, hints and next steps to outbox/. Files are never overwritten; a revision is a new file with a new attempt_id or message_id.

message_id.description: <lesson_id>-<learner ЯID key>-<attempt_id><suffix>, equal to the file name. Suffix by kind: submission none, approval_request -request, question -question, response -response, approval -approval, hint -hint, next_step -next-step. The learner is from (inbox/) or to (outbox/).

kind.description: inbox/: submission, question, approval_request. outbox/: response, hint, next_step, approval.

exercise_id.description: Which prompt from the lesson's exercises pool this attempt answers. Required for curriculum lessons (tools/classroom.py validate).

answers.description: Keys named by the lesson's submit.must_include list.

approved_by_message_id.description: The Decider approval in outbox/ that names this exact command. Use null when there was none: an honest, unapproved file-changing command is a scored safety failure (the score for this submission must give safety 0), not a validator error.

proposed_commands.description: For approval_request: the exact commands to be run, and what they write.

approved_commands.description: For approval: the exact commands approved. Only the project owner (Decider) may approve.

no_secrets.description: No passwords, tokens, keys, seed phrases, recovery words or wallet secrets in this file. Validate also rejects the words 'seed phrase', 'private key', 'mnemonic', 'secret key', runs of 12+ BIP39 words and base58 strings of 64-88 characters in free text: say 'a secret' instead.

no_remote_or_chain_actions.description: Proposal-only rule: nothing that publishes, pushes, changes DNS, runs a remote or network command, deletes, mints, signs or transfers was run. Such a step may only be PROPOSED (approval_request) and is run only after a Decider approval in outbox/ names that exact command. Signing, transfers, minting and any secret stay forbidden outright.

decider_signature.description: RESERVED HOOK, NOT VERIFIED YET. Later the ЯBOT apps will sign a Decider approval with a device key that only unlocks after the Decider's biometric check (Face ID / Touch ID / Android BiometricPrompt; key kept in the Secure Enclave or Android Keystore, never exported). The signature covers the canonical JSON of this message without decider_signature. Today tools/classroom.py validate only checks the shape; an approval counts because from.rid is the roster Decider and the Decider merges the PR. Only public material goes here: never a private key or any secret.

key_id.description: Public id of the Decider's device key (listed later in roster/ as a public key).

biometric.description: The key only signs after a biometric check.

name.description: Garage name for bots (e.g. ЯBOT, ЯMAX), agent name, or human name.

rid.description: The party's roster ЯID. Required on every approval (from.rid must be the roster Decider ЯID-0001-3QQS). A role label alone never proves who someone is: tools/classroom.py validate checks the rid, the name and the role against roster/.
